fields.label: Replacement Thresholds
fields.description: Vehicles reaching these thresholds contribute to their replacement score. Each metric is scored 0-100 based on how close the vehicle is to its threshold.

fields.label: Age Threshold (Years)
fields.description: Maximum recommended vehicle age in years. Vehicles at or above this age score 100% on the age metric.

fields.label: Mileage Threshold (KM)
fields.description: Maximum recommended odometer reading in kilometers.

fields.label: Cost-to-Value Ratio Threshold
fields.description: When total lifetime repair cost divided by vehicle book value exceeds this ratio, the vehicle scores 100% on this metric. Example: 0.5 means replacement is flagged when repair costs reach 50% of value.

fields.label: Downtime Threshold (Days/Year)
fields.description: Maximum acceptable downtime days in the last 12 months.

fields.label: Maintenance Frequency Threshold
fields.description: Maximum acceptable number of repair orders in the last 12 months.

fields.label: Scoring Weights
fields.description: How much each metric contributes to the final replacement score (0-100). Weights must sum to 100.

fields.label: Age Weight (%)
fields.description: Contribution of vehicle age to the replacement score.

fields.label: Mileage Weight (%)
fields.description: Contribution of odometer reading to the replacement score.

fields.label: Cost Ratio Weight (%)
fields.description: Contribution of cost-to-value ratio to the replacement score.

fields.label: Downtime Weight (%)
fields.description: Contribution of downtime days to the replacement score.

fields.label: Maintenance Frequency Weight (%)
fields.description: Contribution of repair order count to the replacement score.

fields.label: Recommendation Thresholds
fields.description: Score boundaries that determine the recommendation label. Scores are 0-100.

fields.label: Keep — Max Score
fields.description: Vehicles scoring at or below this value are recommended to Keep.

fields.label: Monitor — Max Score
fields.description: Vehicles scoring above Keep threshold but at or below this value are recommended to Monitor. Above this value → Replace.

fields.label: Scoring Formula
fields.options:
For each metric:

metric_score = min(100, (actual_value / threshold) × 100) × (weight / 100)


Final Replacement Score:

score = age_score + mileage_score + cost_ratio_score + downtime_score + maintenance_freq_score


Recommendation:

score ≤ Keep Max → Keep

score ≤ Monitor Max → Monitor

score > Monitor Max → Replace
